sections.title: Atomic Structure
points: Atom: The smallest indivisible particle of matter that participates in chemical changes.
Protons: Positively charged particles in the center (Nucleus).
Neutrons: Neutral particles (no charge) in the nucleus.
Electrons: Negatively charged particles that orbit the nucleus. Moving electrons are what create electricity.

sections.title: Static Electricity & Lightning
points: Static Electricity: Imbalance of charges on the surface of an insulator caused by friction.
Law of Electrostatics: Like charges repel; unlike charges attract.
Nitrogen Fixation: A major biological benefit where lightning turns atmospheric nitrogen into nitrates for soil fertility.
Speed Fact: We see lightning before thunder because light travels at 300,000 km/s while sound is only 0.33 km/s.

sections.text: Safety: Pointed spikes on lightning conductors are essential because they 'leak' or attract charges more effectively. During a storm, avoid water and trees—they are conductors!
